summary: New York REIT Liquidating LLC filed an 8-K updating unitholders on its indirect investment in One Worldwide Plaza. The $940M first mortgage and $190M senior mezzanine loan are in monetary default; the senior mezzanine lender, an Extell affiliate, acquired and accelerated the loan. A UCC foreclosure sale was enjoined unsuccessfully, and a mortgage foreclosure action with receiver appointment is underway. The filing details loan defaults and litigation rather than a transaction. The registrant is a liquidating vehicle, so this is a restructuring/credit event. What to watch: outcome of foreclosure sale and potential recovery for unitholders.
